autoresearch.description: Single-GPU LLM training loop (nanochat-derived). Agent edits train.py. Repo source lives at the submodule root (no `src/` subdir), so default_scope is './'.

click.description: Composable CLI parsing library. Modular layout (core.py, types.py, parser.py, utils.py, exceptions.py, termui.py) gives clean caller↔callee chains for hard-tier multi-file edits. Stdlib-only at runtime.

httpx.description: Modern Python HTTP client (sync + async). Many small pure-Python helpers in httpx/_*.py; pinned to 0.28.1.

requests.description: HTTP client library. Clean layered design (Session, HTTPAdapter, PreparedRequest).
